{"consolidated_memory":"## Truncated Documents in search/indexer/chunker.ts - Two Separate Incidents

**File:** search/indexer/chunker.ts (search side)
**Stack:** TypeScript
**Test coverage:** search/indexer/chunker.test.ts
**Repro:** index the long changelog fixture

### Incident 1: Cache Invalidation Issue [2026-06-15]
- **Affected users:** only those sitting in negative UTC offset
- **Problem:** truncated documents in the chunker
- **Signal:** chunk offsets that stop short of the document length
- **Root cause:** cache entry that was never invalidated on write
- **Fix:** invalidated the cache entry inside the write transaction
- **PR:** #3294 on branch fix/truncated-documents-1
- **Outcome:** error rate dropped from 3.4% to under 5 per 10,000 (0.05%)

### Incident 2: Clock Skew Issue [2026-08-05]
- **Affected records:** only those carrying non-ASCII names
- **Problem:** truncated documents in the chunker
- **Signal:** chunk offsets that stop short of the document length
- **Root cause:** clock skew between the two hosts
- **Fix:** switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
- **PR:** #4625 on branch fix/truncated-documents-2
- **Outcome:** job finished in 90 minutes instead of 3 hours

Both incidents manifested with identical symptoms but required different fixes due to distinct root causes."}
